title: Offense, penalty.
bodyText: Each day that this part is violated shall be a separate offense. Any person, firm, partnership, or corporation who violates this part shall be fined not more than $500.
bodyHtml: §328-64  Offense, penalty.  Each day that this part is violated shall be a separate offense.  Any person, firm, partnership, or corporation who violates this part shall be fined not more than $500. [L 1967, c 206, pt of §1; HRS §328-64]
